name: Robocar Poli
description: When disaster strikes in Brooms Town, police car Robocar Poli, fire truck Robotruck Roy and their friends on the rescue team race to save the day.

videos.title: Rescue Team of Broom’s Town
videos.overview: When Tanguy the truck bumps into a mooring post at the dock and drives away unaware that his brakes are out, the rescue team tries to intercept him.

videos.title: SchoolB’s Present
videos.overview: SchoolB wants to give balloons to the kids he takes to school. But when the balloons fly away, it's up to the Rescue Team to get them back.

videos.title: Concrete Fuss
videos.overview: Despite Mr. Builder's warnings about the wet concrete, Bruner takes a spill and falls right in. Now, the Rescue Team must find a way to help.

videos.title: New Friends
videos.overview: Cleany takes in a lost cat and the two become fast friends. But when the cat's owner comes calling, Cleany has trouble saying goodbye.

videos.title: Regular Checkup Day
videos.overview: The team learns the importance of regular checkups when Spooky accidentally starts a fire after skipping his appointment with the nurse.

videos.title: Fuss About Ghost
videos.overview: When Cap spreads a rumor about a spooky ghost living in the forest, three kid cars set out to discover if ghosts are real or just pretend.

videos.title: Try Not to Hurry
videos.overview: When the town's streets are blocked for repairs, SchoolB rushes to find an alternate route and learns that being in a hurry can lead to accidents.

videos.title: I Want to Be Praised
videos.overview: Jealous when Poke is praised for digging up a valuable old tire, Bruner sets out to make a find of his own but soon runs into trouble.

videos.title: Trust Your Friends
videos.overview: During a rainstorm, some tires go missing from Wheeler's store. Is there a thief in town, or does the mystery have another explanation?

videos.title: Helly's Birthday
videos.overview: Helly is disappointed when nobody remembers his birthday. Later, Poli and the gang search for a way to make it up to their friend.

videos.title: Where Are You Going, Cleany?
videos.overview: When an out-of-order charging station sends Cleany into overdrive, it's up to the Rescue Team to calm him down before someone gets hurt.

videos.title: Mickey Is Angry!
videos.overview: Mickey can't understand why his friends don't care about guarding the wet concrete. He vows to do it himself but ends up in a sticky situation.

videos.title: I Love You, Grandpa!
videos.overview: When Grandpa Musty gives Mini an old-fashioned spare tire, she worries her friends will make fun of her because the tire isn't exactly cool.

videos.title: It's Okay to Make a Mistake
videos.overview: When Posty spots Spooky making a mistake, he shares the story with his friends. But Posty soon learns that mistakes happen -- even to him.

videos.title: Talent Contest
videos.overview: The gang's getting excited about the town's talent show. When Dump rushes his work so he won't miss the contest, he ends up needing some help.

videos.title: Keep Your Promise
videos.overview: When Annie loses track of her doll, SchoolB promises to help. But finding the doll may be too big a job for SchoolB without some assistance.

videos.title: Please, Cleany!
videos.overview: When too many of his friends ask for his help at once, Cleany tries to make everyone happy. Instead, he winds up in a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Let’s Be Clean!
videos.overview: Spooky wants to break the record for the longest time between baths. But when he's mistaken for a filthy monster, he realizes it's good to be clean.

videos.title: The Friendship Tree
videos.overview: When Cap and Posty get stuck between two trees, they must put their bickering aside and remember why they're best friends in the first place.

videos.title: Remember, Max!
videos.overview: Max's bad memory has everyone worried. When a fire breaks out, it's up to Max to pass along the location to the Rescue Team -- if he can remember it.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: When Mary falls asleep in a pipe that's about to be used in construction, Cleany calls on the Rescue Team to help his friend before it's too late.

videos.title: Beny’s Dream
videos.overview: Beny wants to be a part of the Rescue Team, like his hero, Roy. But when Beny gets a chance to show his stuff, he finds himself in over his head.

videos.title: Escape from the Energy Crisis
videos.overview: When the town's energy runs out, it's up to the Rescue Team to get the lights back on and teach people the importance of conserving.

videos.title: Whose Side Should I Be On?
videos.overview: While playing ball, Posty and Cap get into a feud. Later, the two friends create an awkward situation when they force Cleany to pick a side.

videos.title: Be Healthy
videos.overview: While patrolling the woodlands, Helly hurts his propeller and must rest while the rest of the Rescue Team sets out to save Terry the truck.

videos.title: Our New Friend, Whooper
videos.overview: Whooper the bus comes to town, and everyone warns him about a big storm. But when Whooper doesn't listen, the Rescue Team must save their new friend.

videos.title: Rody Is a Liar
videos.overview: Rody thinks that making prank calls to Rescue Team is all in good fun, but when a friend runs into danger, Rody must learn to change his ways.

videos.title: Greedy Mr. Wheeler
videos.overview: Mr. Wheeler isn't known for being the nicest guy in town. When he gets stuck on his roof, he wonders if anybody will bother to help him down.

videos.title: I Like the Circus
videos.overview: After Spooky sees a circus perform, he starts doing dangerous tricks on his own, unaware that he might be putting himself in danger.

videos.title: Swampy Situation
videos.overview: When Bruner starts acting like a bully, some of his friends decide to play without him in the woods. Will Bruner get a chance to make things right?

videos.title: Mini’s Present
videos.overview: The Rescue Team leaps into action when Mini gets stuck after venturing down a steep hill to retrieve her grandpa's new reading glasses.

videos.title: Leky, Lefy, Lety
videos.overview: The Crane triplets have had it with everybody getting their names mixed up, so Helly creates a catchy song to help solve the problem.

videos.title: Let’s Play Together, Poke
videos.overview: A mute excavator named Poke feels sad when he can't play a word game with his friends. He runs away, so his friends call on Rescue Team to help.

videos.title: Thank You, Cleany
videos.overview: Titan is always refusing Cleany's offers to help. But when Cleany notices that one of Titan's wheels may fall off, the big truck may change his tune.

videos.title: Spooky and a Swarm of Bees
videos.overview: While out enjoying a drive, Spooky chases a bee back to its hive. But when Spooky disturbs the hive, he ends up the one being chased.

videos.title: I Like Myself
videos.overview: Max feels left out when he learns he's unable to participate in the Brooms Town track and field competition.

videos.title: Annie’s Trip
videos.overview: SchoolB tries to cheer up Annie by taking her on an outing. But when Annie slips near the edge of a cliff, Rescue Team leaps into action.

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: After Cleany finds a treasure map, he and Posty set out to find the riches. When Cleany takes a scary fall, it's up to Posty to get help.

videos.title: A Friend Under the Sea
videos.overview: When a singing dolphin named Ming Ming gets sick after accidentally eating a piece of trash, the gang must use a periscope to save their new friend.

videos.title: Thinking of Granddaughter
videos.overview: Mr. Wheeler receives a new computer from his granddaughter. While trying to set it up, he accidentally causes an emergency worthy of the Rescue Team.

videos.title: Trash Commotion
videos.overview: Everybody must pitch in when the town's trash starts to pile up at the recycling center, and Cleany gets stuck in a puddle of spilled glue.

videos.title: Bruner’s New Ball
videos.overview: Bruner's buddies accidentally drop his fancy new ball in a stream. When Poke goes in after it, Rescue Team must hurry to save the day.

videos.title: I Want It
videos.overview: After Mini stumbles upon Mr. Wheeler's lost snow globe, she lies about finding it. When Mr. Wheeler falls into a pit, will Mini tell the truth?

videos.title: Where Are You, Jin?
videos.overview: Jin and the children are caught in a rainstorm, with no way to call for help. The Rescue Team will have to track them down in order to save the day.

videos.title: The Secret of Poke
videos.overview: While doing construction, Poke finds a beautiful dandelion. He replants the flower out of harm's way but worries more construction may ruin it.

videos.title: Weird SchoolB
videos.overview: SchoolB decides to get painted white instead of yellow, but he soon regrets it when the school children tell him he looks like a ghost.

videos.title: Brave Mr. Musty
videos.overview: When the kid cars are tricked and taken by the evil Truck X, Mr. Musty calls on Rescue Team to help save the little ones.

videos.title: Please Hear Me Out
videos.overview: When Mickey gets mad at Beny and Rody for marking up fresh concrete, Mr. Builder steps in and takes sides without knowing all the facts.

videos.title: Cap Is Neat
videos.overview: Cap's love of keeping clean gets him in trouble when he uses the car wash so much that it breaks and traps him inside.

videos.title: Mystery Mail
videos.overview: Posty sets out to discover who is sending letters addressed to "Thank You." Meanwhile, Jin is upset that she never seems to get any mail.

videos.title: Harmony of Brooms Town: Partea 1
videos.overview: A big choir competition has everyone excited, except for Cleany, who worries that his friends might make fun of his voice.

videos.title: Harmony of Brooms Town: Partea 2
videos.overview: Some members of the newly chosen choir drop out after having trouble singing in harmony, leaving Amber to blame herself for the problems.

videos.title: Brooms Town’s Visitor
videos.overview: When a travel journalist named Camp visits Brooms Town to write an article, his rude behavior has the Rescue Team wondering what's wrong.

videos.title: Save Helly
videos.overview: As a hurricane bears down on Brooms Town, Jin orders Helly to stay grounded for his safety. When Helly doesn't listen, things get dangerous.

videos.title: Don’t Worry SchoolB
videos.overview: After having bad dreams about driving down a dark path, an exhausted SchoolB starts sleep-racing and ends up in a prickly situation.

videos.title: Bruner's Little Cousin
videos.overview: Annoyed at having to look after his little cousin, Bruner plays a trick that leads to a dangerous situation. Can the Rescue Team save the day?

videos.title: A Gift for Cleany
videos.overview: Cleany's birthday is just around the corner, and everybody's struggling to come up with the perfect gift for their generous friend.

videos.title: Our Secret Clubhouse
videos.overview: Tired of the playground always being full, Mini, Beny and Rody play in a deserted home. When it starts to collapse, the Rescue Team races to help.

videos.title: Terry’s New Friend
videos.overview: Lifty's clumsiness starts to annoy Terry at the harbor, so the new car works doubly hard, not knowing that he's putting himself in danger.

videos.title: Helly’s Pinwheel
videos.overview: A toy store giveaway leads to mix-ups and misunderstandings among the residents of Brooms Town. It's up to the Rescue Team to repair friendships.

videos.title: Mickey's Lonely
videos.overview: While retrieving a ball from Mickey's yard, Bruner accidentally falls into a cement machine. The Rescue Team races to help their stuck buddy.

videos.title: Drawing Lines
videos.overview: Mini, Rody and Beny get into an argument over a mess of toys. They decide to divide up the play area but soon get carried away.

videos.title: Let's Draw
videos.overview: After Poke discovers he has a talent for art, he starts drawing pictures everywhere. But not everyone thinks that's a good idea.

videos.title: I Need a Friend
videos.overview: Lifty worries that he won't be able to make friends. But after an accident, he realizes he has a lot in common with everyone in Brooms Town.

videos.title: Please Stop My Hiccups
videos.overview: When Cleany develops a bad case of the hiccups, members of the Rescue Team do everything they can to help their friend get back to normal.

videos.title: Poli’s Secret
videos.overview: Camp returns to Brooms Town with a neat caterpillar collection. Everybody's excited to see it except Poli, who has a secret he'd rather not share.

videos.title: The Invitation
videos.overview: Cap plans a party to celebrate being named Brooms Town's most stylish citizen. But feelings get hurt when Spooky doesn't get an invitation.

videos.title: Spooky Plays Sick
videos.overview: When Cleany falls ill, everyone in Brooms Town pays him a visit and wishes him well. Spooky gets jealous and pretends to be sick.

videos.title: Multiple Mix-up
videos.overview: Mini is excited to get a present from Grandpa Musty, but a mix-up leads to frustration and inspires the Rescue Team to help their friend.

videos.title: Let's Be Honest
videos.overview: After making an innocent mistake, Helly lies to Jin about a broken invention. Later, a fire at Spooky's puts Helly in danger.

videos.title: Max Gets a Fish
videos.overview: Max persuades Mr. Builder to buy him a pet fish and vows to take care of it. But when Camp invites him on an outing, Max forgets about his promise.

videos.title: Let's Follow the Rules
videos.overview: A new charging station in town is supposed to be used for emergencies only, but some of Brooms Town's residents have trouble following the rules.

videos.title: You Can Do It, Mr. Builder
videos.overview: While worrying about a construction project, Mr. Builder falls ill. It's up to his crew to work harder and ease some of the boss's stress.

videos.title: Cleany Gets Angry
videos.overview: Spooky realizes that Cleany never gets upset, no matter what. Determined to see his friend angry, Spooky conducts a series of pranks.

videos.title: The Hottest Day in Brooms Town
videos.overview: A heat wave hits Brooms Town and while all the residents are urged to stay out of the sun, not everyone heeds the Rescue Team's warning.

videos.title: Ms. Belle’s Medal
videos.overview: While helping Ms. Belle move her stuff, Lifty accidentally loses her military medal. Eager to prove he's not a thief, Lifty tries to track it down.

videos.title: Who Is Taller?
videos.overview: Who is Brooms Town's tallest resident? A debate becomes a loud argument when everyone chimes in. The Rescue Team tries to defuse the feud.

videos.title: Amber’s Training
videos.overview: Amber shows her persistence while learning to climb a cliff. Meanwhile, a mysterious tree disease puts everyone in Brooms Town on edge.

videos.title: A Suspicious Friend
videos.overview: A rumor about a monster living in the forest puts everyone on edge. But when the residents investigate, they learn the truth is a lot less scary.

videos.title: It's Good to Tidy Up
videos.overview: It's Spooky's day off, and he really wants someone to come over and play. But because his place is so messy, nobody wants to go.

videos.title: I'm Going to Do Whatever I Want
videos.overview: Bruny wants to do things his way and ignore the safety rules. But after he gets stuck in a tree, he might be ready to change his tune.

videos.title: Helly’s Wish
videos.overview: Envious of his friends, Helly trades his propeller for wheels. But when Camp needs a helicopter rescue, Helly sees why flying is so important.

videos.title: We Look Alike
videos.overview: Confusion sweeps through Brooms Town when Mr. Builder borrows some of Mr. Wheeler's clothes and the two discover they look a lot alike.

videos.title: Marine’s Dream
videos.overview: When Lifty and Terry hear that Marine has never been camping, they conspire to give their waterbound friend the surprise of a lifetime.

videos.title: The Unpoppable Bubble
videos.overview: While playing with Jin's new bubble invention, Mickey accidentally starts to float away. It's up to the Rescue Team to think fast and find a solution.

videos.title: A Spring Cleaning Disaster
videos.overview: While working to clean up Brooms Town, Posty accidentally tosses his beloved stamp collection. Now, he must find it before it's lost forever.

videos.title: Where's Bruny?
videos.overview: Bruner asks Max to look after Bruny. But when Max gets distracted, Bruny disappears. The Rescue Team must do what it takes to find their missing pal.

videos.title: The Fortune Cookie
videos.overview: A message inside a fortune cookie inspires Spooky and Lifty to travel westward. Little do the friends know they're heading straight for danger.

videos.title: Tracky's Special Invitation
videos.overview: While SchoolB seeks suggestions on where to take the kids for their activity, Tracky looks for ways to make his farm look spiffy.

videos.title: I Want to Go to Sea
videos.overview: Anxious to explore the sea, Rody stows away with Marine. When bad weather hits, Rody takes a spill and the Rescue Team must save their friend.

videos.title: Move Out! Battle in the Woods (1)
videos.overview: Helly stumbles upon a trap in the Wildlife Reserve that leads the Rescue Team on an important mission across Brooms Town and beyond.

videos.title: Move Out! Battle in the Woods (2)
videos.overview: Mark and Bucky help the Rescue Team work together to pursue the dangerous Poacher before he can make yet another escape.

videos.title: Please Accept My Apology
videos.overview: While in the middle of a game of hide-and-seek with Lifty, Max leaves to run an errand. Lifty is furious, and Max must find a way to apologize.

videos.title: Bruner's Birthday Secret
videos.overview: Bruner really wants a particular present for his birthday. When his friends refuse to tell him what they bought, Bruner goes searching for clues.

videos.title: Miracle at Tracky's Farm
videos.overview: When a drought hits, Jin asks that everyone cut back on their water usage. As Tracky's farm begins to suffer, the Rescue Team reaches out for help.

videos.title: Boom! Crash! Danger!
videos.overview: As a lightning storm brews, Mini, Benny and Rody head to Galaxy Hill for a closer look. When disaster strikes, the Rescue Team must heed the call.

videos.title: Camp's Secret Plan
videos.overview: Camp visits Brooms Town a day early but keeps it a secret. Later, when he doesn't appear, his friends start to worry something may have happened.

videos.title: Fishing Commotion
videos.overview: Desperate to catch a fish for Ms. Belle, Lety stays up too late and shows up tired for work, where he's even more clumsy than usual.

videos.title: Thank You, Roy
videos.overview: Roy learns the importance of resting his body when he pushes himself too hard during a hectic workday and makes an injury worse.

videos.title: Disappearance of Spooky
videos.overview: After Jin invents an invisible laser machine, Spooky sneaks in and experiments on himself. Unfortunately, when he needs help, nobody can see him.

videos.title: Helping Each Other When Things Are Difficult
videos.overview: Dump and Bruner head to the harbor to pick up a shipment, but bickering over who should carry what leads to a preventable accident.

videos.title: Tracky's Present
videos.overview: Grateful for Mr. Wheeler's kindness, Tracky brings him a basket of raspberries. Meanwhile, residents hear rumors of a snake sighting.

videos.title: The Brooms Town Railroad Station
videos.overview: The Rescue Team reports for duty when Lifty, Terry, Bruner and Dump -- feeling rushed to reach their destinations -- get into a jam near Frog Bridge.

videos.title: Our Fabulous New Friend
videos.overview: To celebrate the completion of the railway station, Mr. Builder plans a party with a special surprise that has Spooky beyond excited.

language: Korean, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, English, Portuguese
